description: 26 template-representative questions (one per template T01-T26) from DABStep. Target: 100%.

T01.pattern: during {year}, imagine if the fee id {fee_id} was only applied to account_type {at}, which merchants would have been affected by this change?

T02.pattern: for a credit transaction of {amount} eur on {card_scheme}, what would be the most expensive authorization characteristics indicator (aci)? in the case of a draw between multiple aci {aci}, return the aci with the lowest alphabetical order. provide the response in a list even if there is only one value.

T03.pattern: for account_type {at} and the mcc description: {mcc_desc}, what would be the average fee that the card scheme {card_scheme} would charge for a transaction value of {amount} eur? provide the answer in eur and 6 decimals

T04.pattern: for account_type {at}, what would be the average fee that the card scheme {card_scheme} would charge for a transaction value of {amount} eur? provide the answer in eur and 6 decimals.

T05.pattern: for credit transactions, what would be the average fee that the card scheme {card_scheme} would charge for a transaction value of {amount} eur?

T06.pattern: for the {day_of_year} of the year {year}, what are the fee ids applicable to {merchant}?

T07.pattern: for the {day_of_year} of the year {year}, what is the total fees (in euros) that {merchant} should pay?

T08.pattern: for {merchant} in {month}, if we were to move the fraudulent transactions towards a different authorization characteristics indicator (aci) by incentivizing users to use a different interaction, what would be the preferred choice considering the lowest possible fees?

T09.pattern: imagine the merchant {merchant} had changed its mcc code {mcc} before {year} started, what amount delta will it have to pay in fees for the year {year}?

T10.pattern: in the average scenario, which card scheme would provide the cheapest fee for a transaction value of {amount} eur?

T11.pattern: in the average scenario, which card scheme would provide the most expensive fee for a transaction value of {amount} eur?

T12.pattern: in the year {year} what delta would {merchant} pay if the relative fee of the fee id {fee_id} changed to {rate}?

T13.pattern: in {month} {year} what delta would {merchant} pay if the relative fee of the fee id {fee_id} changed to {rate}?

T14.pattern: in {year}, which merchants were affected by the fee id {fee_id}?

T15.pattern: looking at the month of {month}, to which card scheme should the merchant {merchant} steer traffic in order to pay the maximum fees?

T16.pattern: looking at the month of {month}, to which card scheme should the merchant {merchant} steer traffic in order to pay the minimum fees?

T17.pattern: looking at the year {year} and at the merchant {merchant}, if we were to move the fraudulent transactions towards a different authorization characteristics indicator (aci) by incentivizing shoppers to use a different payment interactions, what would be the preferred choice considering the lowest possible fees?

T18.pattern: looking at the year {year}, to which card scheme should the merchant {merchant} steer traffic to in order to pay the maximum fees?

T19.pattern: looking at the year {year}, to which card scheme should the merchant {merchant} steer traffic to in order to pay the minimum fees?

T20.pattern: what are the applicable fee ids for {merchant} in {year}?

T21.pattern: what are the total fees (in euros) that {merchant} paid in {month} {year}?

T22.pattern: what are the total fees (in euros) that {merchant} paid in {year}?

T23.pattern: what is the average transaction value grouped by {group_col} for {merchant} {card_scheme} transactions between {month} and {month} {year}?

T24.pattern: what is the fee id or ids that apply to account_type {at} and aci {aci}?

T25.pattern: what is the most expensive mcc for a transaction of {amount} eur, in general? if there are many mccs with the same value, list all of them. provide a list as an output even if it is one element.

T26.pattern: what were the applicable fee ids for {merchant} in {month} {year}?
